propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE at src/rebar/llm/completion.py:48-65 omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence, directing callers to futile ticket-comment-only retries on untagged criteria.
ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md:81-86 deliberately treat untagged external criteria as codebase-verifiable and reject ticket-only evidence; the remediation guidance contradicts this contract.

The remediation wording must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and state that an untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone.

The strengthened remediation interface test requires the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite and the untagged-external fallback and must fail RED against the old guidance and pass GREEN after the fix.
